**ValueAPI** is an AI API gateway that provides access to leading proprietary models alongside a $10 free sign-up credit without requiring a credit card upfront.[1]

## ValueAPI Gateway Overview

The platform acts as a unified LLM API gateway, connecting applications to over 500 language models through a single OpenAI-compatible base URL. New accounts receive a complimentary $10 balance upon registration, allowing developers to test API integrations and call endpoints immediately.[1]

Because it implements the standard OpenAI chat completion schema, developers can swap existing client base URLs and API keys without rewriting application code. The service features automated fallback chains, latency monitoring, and policy-based request routing to balance cost against response quality.[1]

## Supported Proprietary Models

The gateway provides unified routing to several major proprietary and open model families, including:

- OpenAI models such as GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, and reasoning-focused variants.[1]
- Anthropic models including the Claude Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku series.[1]
- Google models spanning the Gemini Pro and Flash families.[1]
- High-performance open-weight models including DeepSeek and Qwen distributions.[1]

Usage for both proprietary and open models is billed on a pay-as-you-go token basis, drawing directly against the $10 credit pool until it is exhausted.[1]

## Alternative Credit Programs

While ValueAPI directly offers $10 upon sign-up, other AI gateways and model providers operate comparable promotions:

- Merge Gateway provides $10 in monthly credit allowances to route traffic across major LLM providers.[2][3]
- Novita AI grants a $10 account credit through its developer referral program, which applies across its serverless model catalog.[4][5]
- AI21 Labs and Upstage supply $10 in trial credits for new accounts, though their access is limited to their proprietary models such as Jamba and Solar.[6][7]
